references.text: Joshua warns Israel that if they mix with the remaining peoples, the Lord will no longer drive them out, and these peoples will become a trap and a snare to them.
Joshua warns that if Israel breaks the covenant and serves other gods, the Lord's anger will burn against them, and they will quickly perish from the good land.
Moses warns that just as the Lord rejoiced in doing good to Israel, he will also rejoice in destroying them if they are disobedient.
The warning that the land will vomit out Israel if they make it unclean, just as it vomited out the peoples who were there before them.
The command to destroy all the peoples and show them no mercy, for they would become a snare to Israel.
The angel of the Lord says that because Israel did not obey, he will not drive out the peoples, and their gods will become a snare to them.
